title: The pitch meeting that isn't, ii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Tuesday. Gully tells Wood about the car. Wood asks nothing. The card is in the bait cooler with the crawlers. The strip lets him not look at it.

panels.composition: Gully's, morning. WOOD on the end stool, coffee. GULLY behind the counter. BARNABY II. The bait cooler's lid up.

balloons.text: Two of 'em. Washington plates. Asked for Arthur Finch.

image.prompt: a thin man on a shop's end stool with coffee and a stocky man in an apron behind the counter with a bait cooler's lid up, a small three-legged dog, razor-sharp ink
image.notes: 'Who's that.' Wood on his own name.

panels.composition: The bait cooler: crawlers in dirt, and among the tubs, a white business card, face down, damp.
props: the card, face down, among the crawlers

image.prompt: close-up inside a bait cooler with tubs of nightcrawlers in dirt and a damp white business card lying face down among them
image.notes: The card from dw_2018-09-17. Face down.

panels.composition: Gully, lid still up, waiting. Wood drinking his coffee. Not looking in the cooler.

image.prompt: a stocky man holding a cooler lid open and waiting while a thin man drinks coffee without looking, dry

panels.composition: The lid closing. Gully back to work. Wood drawing. The pup asleep. The card under the crawlers for as long as the strip runs.

image.prompt: a stocky man closing a bait cooler's lid while a thin man draws on a stool and a small dog sleeps, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: 'Who's that.' The card stays under the crawlers.
